children: Asia-focused investment firm PAG will acquire a 51% stake in Evergrande Property Services Group
for HK$4.03 billion  ($513.64 million), the unit of debt-laden developer China Evergrande Group said on Friday.

The offer values the 5.52 billion shares at HK$0.8359 each, a 29% discount to Evergrande Property's last closing price on Wednesday. The stock was suspended on Thursday pending the announcement and will resume trading later on Friday.
Following completion of the deal, PAG's unit will be required to make an unconditional offer for the remaining 5.3 billion shares in the company.
The transaction marks a key step in the efforts of Evergrande's liquidators to recover funds for creditors owed a combined $45 billion.
China Evergrande, once the country's premier property developer, defaulted on most of its $300 billion in liabilities following Beijing's sweeping crackdown on the property sector six years ago.
Its liquidators informed the indebted property developer a year ago that they were seeking ‌to sell a 51.016% stake in Evergrande Property Services.
PAG intends for Evergrande Property Services to remain listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, the property firm said in an exchange filing.
